summary.intent: Update the codebase map documents (CONCERNS.md, STRUCTURE.md) to reflect work completed in phases 28-33, then do broader planning doc cleanup including DEFERRED.md, todos, milestone docs, and the security backlog.
summary.outcome: Updated CONCERNS.md and STRUCTURE.md on a docs branch (PR #390), cleaned DEFERRED.md and security LOW-SEVERITY-BACKLOG.md on a second docs branch (PR #391), sanitized a dev IP from 15 planning files, and suppressed Entire CLI hook artifacts from git status.

repo: Phase 28 resolved: pervasive console.log (replaced with structured logger at apps/web/src/lib/logger.ts), legacy POC removal (ee9bcd4e4), and low-severity security items #13-17, #19 from the desktop phase review.

Phase 30 resolved: web app observability gap via Grafana Faro (apps/web/src/lib/faro.ts) and Prometheus metrics (apps/api/src/metrics/). New gap: registerFaroTransport() is defined but never called, so logger.error/warn calls don't reach Faro.

Phase 31 resolved: monolithic file concern — useSharedNavigation.ts dropped from 1199→378 lines, FileBrowser.tsx from 964→362 lines. folder.service.ts (1059) and bin.service.ts (971) remain large but are now below the threshold for a formal concern.

Phase 32+33 resolved: FUSE FilePointer sync resolution — both macOS (crates/fuse/src/read_ops.rs) and Windows (crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/read_ops.rs) now use async via rt.spawn() channel patterns.
New concern: 19+ mutex lock().unwrap() sites in FUSE production code can cause cascading panics on mutex poison.
New concern: 12 unguarded console.time/timeEnd calls remain in apps/web/src/lib/web3auth/hooks.ts, surviving Phase 28.
IPNS unenrollment is handled fire-and-forget by SDK with no persistence across tab closure — still an open concern.
The Entire CLI injects its own git hooks (post-commit, pre-push, prepare-commit-msg, commit-msg.pre-entire) alongside husky, creating untracked files in .git/hooks/.
192.168.133.114 (docker host IP) was referenced in 15 planning files but was never in source/config — replaced with <docker-host> placeholder across all files.

code.finding: Stale concern about legacy POC code still in repo — POC was removed in Phase 28 commit ee9bcd4e4, directory no longer exists.
Stale reference to docker host IP (192.168.133.114) — removed as no longer accurate.
Status column in env vars table contained phase annotations (Phase 28), (Phase 30), and (generated) labels — removed as unnecessary noise in a reference doc.
Summary table was stale — 6 Phase 9 items (#13-19, except #18 which was already marked) had been resolved but not reflected. Updated to show 7 resolved, 12 open.

workflow: When main has diverged and you have local commits, stash the work, reset to origin/main, then restore — avoids a rebase/merge conflict for planning-only doc changes.
gsd-codebase-mapper agents write documents directly and return only confirmation + line counts, keeping orchestrator context minimal.
Concerns mapper is effective at cross-referencing commit history against existing concern entries to determine resolved vs. new status.
Git local exclude (.git/info/exclude) is the right place to suppress machine-local tool artifacts (like Entire CLI hooks) without modifying .gitignore.

friction: git pull failed due to divergent branches after the initial docs commit — had to stash, reset to origin/main, and re-run the concerns mapper against the updated codebase (Phase 33 had merged in the interim).
The first CONCERNS.md run (233 lines) had to be discarded and redone after pulling Phase 33, adding latency to the workflow.
PR gh command failed on first attempt and required a retry.
STRUCTURE.md table status column required 4 separate Edit tool calls to clean up phase/generated annotations — the edits weren't batched efficiently.
open_items: registerFaroTransport() is defined but never called — logger.error/warn calls don't reach Grafana Faro (observability gap).
12 console.time/timeEnd calls in apps/web/src/lib/web3auth/hooks.ts not covered by Phase 28 logging work.
19+ mutex lock().unwrap() sites in FUSE production code — risk of cascading panics on mutex poison.
IPNS unenrollment has no persistence across tab closure — fire-and-forget SDK call only.
folder.service.ts (1059 lines) and bin.service.ts (971 lines) are candidates for future decomposition.
12 low-severity security backlog items from Phase 5 review remain open (items #1-12, except partial #11).
All 12 pending todos checked and confirmed still pending — none resolved by phases 28-33.
